purpose: ASAP7 native interval model calibration under verified electrical capture loads; original failed independent test sealed
grouping: complete width/native-template/capture-bank source family, including every stage and any target variant; no row-random split
intervals: all nonempty contiguous complete native legal-group intervals

context.capture: unconditional distinct banks with per-bank parity observation outside core
context.clock_reset_enable: unchanged launch reset/enable; capture has no control mux

interior_width_crossfit.algorithm: same candidate family/hyperparameters as full training fit

calibration.delay_reserve: max(1, maximum validation actual/predicted ratio, maximum interior-crossfit actual/predicted ratio) * 1.05

selection: train fit and train-only interior-width cross-fit, apply reserve from eligible train/validation only, test original validation gates after reserve, then validation normalized MAE and serialized complexity; area uses original unscaled validation gates
quality_scope: every interval class separately; no post-test aggregation to rescue a failed class
production_query_scope: one capture bank implied by the verified shared-chain pipeline; no new multi-bank runtime architecture claim
independence_claim: new complete source/load topologies at previously exposed widths20/28; not unseen-width generalization
inheritance: only exact predecessor single-bank train/validation sources and actual measurements; frozen explicit reuse identity, original failed independent test excluded

excluded_independent_test.rule: never train, calibrate, choose algorithms/margins or retest using these labels

mapped_bank_audit: each declared bank must have a real source-Q to capture-D path and a positive distinct mapped DFF set <= static capacity; no overlap/missing bank, equal retained bank counts, actual counts never used as predictor input
